LANDING.HERO_SUB: Post a job, watch offers roll in live, pick the best price. Pay only when the work is done — zero risk.
LANDING.HOW_TITLE: Three steps to a fixed home
LANDING.STEP1_DESC: Write a short description, add photos if you have them, and let our Gemini AI turn it into a crisp brief — plus suggest the right worker type.
LANDING.STEP2_DESC: Matched handymen receive your request instantly over WebSockets and submit price quotes in real time — pick the best offer.
LANDING.STEP3_DESC: The handyman comes, does the work, and you mark it finished. Payment via Paymob only happens at that exact moment — never before.
LANDING.FEAT_TITLE: Everything you need, nothing you don't
LANDING.WORKER_DESC: Get a live feed of jobs matching your skill set — plumbing, electrical, carpentry, IT and more. Set your own price, build your rating, and get paid through Paymob the moment a job is marked done.
LANDING.WORKER_BULLET3: ⭐ Build a public rating over time
LANDING.WORKER_BULLET4: 🏪 Optional shop profile for extra trust
LANDING.CTA_DESC: Join Handy for free — post a request in under a minute.
LANDING.FEAT0_DESC: Take a photo of the issue and add a short description — our AI polishes it and suggests the right worker type.
LANDING.FEAT1_DESC: Matched handymen see your request in real time and submit quotes within seconds — no waiting for callbacks.
LANDING.FEAT2_DESC: Every handyman carries their public rating from past finished jobs. Pick with confidence.
LANDING.FEAT3_DESC: You're charged only after you mark the job finished — zero risk of paying for work that didn't happen.
LANDING.FEAT4_DESC: Plumbers, electricians, carpenters, IT technicians — the right expert for every problem.
LANDING.FEAT5_DESC: Phone numbers are verified via OTP on WhatsApp at sign-up — every user is real.
